name: Kargathia Keep
summary: Warsong overseers hold the eastern edge of their lumber camp at Kargathia Keep. The fortified stronghold guards the Southfury River border in Ashenvale and links the outpost to Orgrimmar.

sections.title: A Bastion on the Southfury
sections.body: Kargathia Keep anchors the eastern edge of the Warsong Lumber Camp, just west of the Southfury River. Spiked barricades fortify the outpost, where Overseer Gorthak and his officers direct the Horde’s logging operations. From the river border, the Warsong clan watches for incursions. When night elf skirmishers strike, reinforcements can come swiftly from Durotar and Orgrimmar.

sections.title: Honoring the Bladefist
sections.body: Kargathia Keep shares its namesake with Kargath in the Badlands and Bladefist Bay on Durotar’s coast: the famed chieftain Kargath Bladefist. For Warsong orcs facing Ashenvale’s hostile woodlands, its imposing architecture speaks of martial resilience and Horde defiance in lands claimed by the night elves.

faq.answer: Kargathia Keep stands in eastern Ashenvale, at the east edge of the Warsong Lumber Camp, just west of the Southfury River.

aliases: who is in charge of kargathia keep
faq.answer: Overseer Gorthak commands the Warsong Lumber Camp from Kargathia Keep, directing logging and defenses against Alliance attacks.

faq.q: Why was the keep named Kargathia?
aliases: who is kargathia keep named after
faq.answer: Kargathia Keep was named for Kargath Bladefist, the legendary chieftain of the Shattered Hand clan. Kargath in the Badlands and Bladefist Bay in Durotar share that naming heritage.

faq.q: What is the strategic purpose of this stronghold?
faq.answer: Kargathia Keep commands the logging camp’s eastern border along the Southfury River, securing the supply route and allowing troops to come swiftly from Orgrimmar.

angles.text: As a Horde defender, you can hold this frontline stronghold in Ashenvale and secure timber shipments vital to Orgrimmar’s construction.
As a night elf, you see this spiked stronghold as a sign of the Horde’s aggressive, entrenched presence in your sacred ancestral forest.
